summary: Frontend UI/UX redesign testing completed. All 10 features tested successfully. Login, dashboard, period selector, navigation arrows, bottom navigation, Stock page KPIs, Production page tabs, Create Mission button, and modals all working correctly. No horizontal overflow detected on mobile (430px).
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI/UX redesign fully tested. All features working correctly on mobile viewport (430px). New design includes Manrope/Work Sans fonts, #2C4A3B forest green palette, glassmorphic bottom nav, pill-shaped period selector.

features_tested.notes: All period buttons (Aujourd'hui, Hier, Semaine, Sem. dern., Ce mois) are clickable and functional
